t: A small metal-cased router and mini PC with an eight-core chip.
steps: Buy the board from the FriendlyElec shop. The bare board is about 230 US dollars and the cased version is about 245.
Get a USB-C power supply with Power Delivery, a microSD card and network cables.
Download the FriendlyWrt eFlasher image from the FriendlyElec wiki.
Write the image to the microSD card with an image writing app.
Boot from the card to install FriendlyWrt on the built-in storage.
Connect a computer to a LAN port and open the FriendlyWrt web page in a browser.
Set a router password and check the internet link.
meta: Open Board. From $230. A few stores.
